rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=3, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=12, batch_size=1, lr=0.00011, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.7, wu_soft_thresh=0.0015, wu_sigmoid_slope=10.0, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-3 (one knob vs iter-1 best). NUMBERS: iter-1 hr=0.3009 (n_bands=6, BEST); iter-2 hr=0.2805 (n_bands=8, WORSE by -0.020) -> extra high-freq bands do NOT help, spectral expressivity is not the bottleneck at 6 bands; reverting to n_bands=6. FAILURE MODE: hr ceiling is set by the residual-refinement path, not the FBP band count. The prior-split doc reported n_outer=3 COLLAPSED (hr->0) but that was at lr=1e-3; at the TPE lr=1.1e-4 (10x lower, iter-1 config) n_outer=3 was NEVER retested -- the collapse may be an lr artifact. ONE KNOB: wu_n_outer 2 -> 3 (adds 2 params: one soft_thresh + one residual_blend -> 14 total, still ultra-low). All else = iter-1. HYPOTHESIS: if I add a 3rd outer soft-thresholded residual-refinement stage at the low TPE lr, I expect val hr to rise above 0.3009 because the extra stage recovers more aliasing residual without the band-runaway that killed the OLD-split n_outer=3 (which ran at 9x higher lr); risk = the classical collapse recurs (watch per-epoch band_scale/soft_thresh/blend). Budget: outer loop dominant cost; iter-1 n_outer=2 was 819s so 3/2x ~= 1230s ~ 20.5min, at the 30-min wall -- acceptable, monitored.
